_doc: Level-up boons. mods add into Abilities.mods (keys documented in docs/team/abilities.md). requires_tag: offered only if you own an ability/weapon with one of these tags (empty = always). on_hit/on_kill: global trigger effects added per stack.

boons.name: Infernal Might
boons.desc: Abilities deal +12% damage.

boons.name: Quickened Rites
boons.desc: Ability cooldowns -7%.

boons.name: Widening Gyre
boons.desc: Ability areas +12%.

boons.name: Legion of Sin
boons.desc: +1 projectile, summon and orbiting object for every ability.

boons.name: Lingering Hate
boons.desc: Status effects, zones and summons last 20% longer.

boons.name: Cruel Edge
boons.desc: +6% critical strike chance for abilities (crits deal double).

boons.name: Kindling
boons.desc: Burning deals +35% damage and stacks 4 higher.

boons.name: Pyroclasm
boons.desc: Burning foes that die burst into flame (radius 1.8).

boons.name: Sulphur Heart
boons.desc: Fire abilities deal +20% damage.

boons.name: Hemophage
boons.desc: Blood abilities cost 20% less life and heal 0.5 HP on kill.

boons.name: Open Veins
boons.desc: Bleeding deals +40% damage. Every ability hit has a 15% chance to cause Bleeding.

boons.name: Crimson Covenant
boons.desc: Blood abilities deal +25% damage.

boons.name: Grave Lord
boons.desc: +1 summon and summons deal +20% damage.

boons.name: Corpse Harvest
boons.desc: Necromancy abilities deal +25% damage. Corpses remain usable 50% longer.

boons.name: Virulence
boons.desc: Plague deals +40% damage and spreads to 1 more foe.

boons.name: Festering Wounds
boons.desc: All damage-over-time ticks 25% faster.

boons.name: Overcharge
boons.desc: +1 lightning jump. Shocked foes take +5% more storm damage per stack.

boons.name: Eye of the Maelstrom
boons.desc: Storm abilities deal +20% damage and cool down 5% faster.

boons.name: Night Blade
boons.desc: Shadow abilities: +10% crit chance, crits deal +50% more.

boons.name: Executioner
boons.desc: Abilities deal +50% damage to foes below 30% health.

boons.name: Tectonic Fury
boons.desc: Brute and melee abilities deal +25% damage and knock foes further.

boons.name: Iron Grip
boons.desc: Bound lasts 50% longer. Bound foes take +15% damage.

boons.name: Deep Hex
boons.desc: Curse stacks 2 higher and each stack adds 3% more damage taken.

boons.name: Soul Glutton
boons.desc: Soul cap +100 and kills have 30% chance to yield an extra Soul.

boons.name: Reaper's Due
boons.desc: Soul abilities deal +20% damage.

boons.name: Simmering Hate
boons.desc: Gain Wrath 50% faster; Wrath abilities deal +15% damage.

boons.name: Endless Grudge
boons.desc: Wrath can stack 20 higher.

boons.name: Gilded Purse
boons.desc: Greed abilities deal +25% damage.

boons.name: Green-Eyed
boons.desc: Envy abilities deal +20% damage and cool down 8% faster.

boons.name: Vanity
boons.desc: Pride abilities deal +25% damage and crit 8% more often.

boons.name: Bottomless Hunger
boons.desc: Gluttony abilities deal +20% damage; meals heal 1 more.

boons.name: Mirrored Self
boons.desc: Illusion abilities deal +25% damage and last 10% longer.

boons.name: Overclocked
boons.desc: Machines deal +15% damage and are built 12% faster.

boons.name: Cat o' Nine Tails
boons.desc: Whips deal +20% damage and crit 10% more often.

boons.name: Hellstorm Covenant
boons.desc: DUO LEGENDARY (fire + storm). Fire and storm abilities +20% damage. Fire hits may arc lightning; storm hits set foes Burning.

boons.name: Gilded Gullet
boons.desc: DUO LEGENDARY (greed + gluttony). Greed and Gluttony +25% damage. Gluttony kills spill Ichor (25%); Greed kills heal 1 HP.

boons.name: Crimson Eclipse
boons.desc: DUO LEGENDARY (blood + shadow). +10% crit, blood abilities +15% crit and cost 25% less life. Shadow hits cause Bleeding (35%).
